title: Amentoflavone, a biflavonoid with potential anticancer properties against viral oncoprotein E6 in Human papilloma virus-16 (HPV-16) positive cervical cancer cells.
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究黄酮类化合物amentoflavone与HPV16-E6蛋白的结合动力学，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且E6为病毒癌蛋白而非转录因子，但MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，相关性有限。
abstract: Cervical cancer is predominantly associated with Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection via HPV16-E6This interdisciplinary investigation investigates the effects of amentoflavone, a bioflavonoid on HPV16-E6, unravelling its impact on the protein's structural dynamics to explore its potential as a therapeutic agent for cervical cancer. MD simulations demonstrated stable binding dynamics between amentoflavone and HPV16-E6. RMSD analysis revealed alterations in the E6 protein structure, and Gibbs binding free energy calculations indicated an energetically favourable interaction. Control simulations enhanced the interpretability of the results. Amentoflavone inhibited the proliferation of SiHa and CaSki cells with GI(50) values of 47.2 +/- 9.64 muM and 29.1 +/- 4.38 muM respectively. Treatment with amentoflavone promoted early and late-phase apoptosis in these cells. The compound reduced HPV-16 E6 while increasing p53-positive populations in SiHa and CaSki cells. In conclusion, the findings of this study suggest that amentoflavone may act as a potential inhibitor of HPV16-E6, disrupting its structural integrity and dynamics.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌主要与人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）感染相关，尤其是通过HPV16-E6。这项跨学科研究探讨了黄酮类化合物阿曼托黄素（amentoflavone）对HPV16-E6的影响，揭示其对该蛋白质结构动态的作用，以探索其作为宫颈癌治疗剂的潜力。分子动力学（MD）模拟显示阿曼托黄素与HPV16-E6之间具有稳定的结合动态。RMSD分析揭示了E6蛋白结构的改变，而吉布斯结合自由能计算表明该相互作用在能量上是有利的。对照模拟增强了结果的可解释性。阿曼托黄素抑制SiHa和CaSki细胞的增殖，其GI(50)值分别为47.2 ± 9.64 μM和29.1 ± 4.38 μM。阿曼托黄素处理促进了这些细胞的早期和晚期凋亡。该化合物降低了HPV-16 E6水平，同时增加了SiHa和CaSki细胞中p53阳性群体。总之，本研究的发现表明，阿曼托黄素可能作为HPV16-E6的潜在抑制剂，破坏其结构完整性和动态。
